{{Infobox auto}}

'''Pad Thai''' is a noodle dish that heals {{Value|Pad Thai|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for {{Value|Pad Thai|duration|effect=Night Vision}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pad_thai.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough, a [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]] or [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], sugar, a carrot, an egg and a [[bowl]]. Picking up a carrot unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pad Thai takes {{Value|Pad Thai|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Pad Thai|heals}} and gives Night Vision for {{Value|Pad Thai|duration|effect=Night Vision|format=clock}}. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_26.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
